name: What are the benefits of upgrading to a pet-resistant screen for my sliding door?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of upgrading to a pet-resistant screen for my sliding door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Upgrading to a pet-resistant screen offers significant advantages if you have cats or dogs. These screens are typically made from thicker, vinyl-coated polyester, making them several times stronger than standard fiberglass screens. This enhanced durability helps prevent tears and holes caused by pets scratching, jumping, or pushing against the screen. It results in a longer-lasting screen, fewer repairs, and maintains a secure barrier against insects, offering peace of mind for pet owners.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pet-resistant screens are much stronger than standard ones, preventing tears and holes from pets and maintaining a secure barrier against insects.
